added.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Location

This role can be based in the UK (Leavesden) or US (Los Angeles or New York)

Your New Role
Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Retail - Global Experiences, the Vice President, Product, Retail is a global leadership role responsible for shaping and delivering the product strategy across Buying, Merchandising, Design, and Product Compliance for the Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) Global Experiences division. The role leads the end‑to‑end retail product ecosystem across studio tours, flagship stores, pop‑ups, e‑commerce and Location Based Entertainment, translating iconic Warner Bros. Discovery franchises & IP into commercially successful, brand‑authentic consumer products that elevate the guest experience.

Your Role Accountabilities
Buying & Merchandising

Lead development of strategies for buying, merchandising and assortment across standalone retail, ecommerce and exit retail for tours, exhibitions and attractions aligned to overall retail strategy.

Craft and direct bespoke product strategies by channel; recognizing distinct guest mindsets, dwell times, price sensitivity and conversion dynamics.

Define frameworks for exclusive, limited-edition and venue specific product creation that drive differentiation, urgency, collectability and attachment. 

Partner closely with Design to commission and deliver custom‑built product ranges unique to Warner Bros. Discovery Global Experiences.

Establish global assortment architectures while enabling geo-specific ranges reflecting local consumer behavior, culture, pricing architecture, size curves, IP relevance and regulatory needs.

Lead merchandise planning, demand forecasting, open-to-buy and SKU productivity across permanent locations and timebound touring experiences.

Drive revenue, margin, sell-through and inventory efficiency using performance analytics, guest insight and postexperience data.

Design & Product Development

Oversee global design and product development teams to translate franchise storytelling into high‑quality, immersive and commercially viable product ranges.

Ensure creative excellence while balancing speed‑to‑market, cost discipline, quality and scalability across global markets.

Product Compliance & Quality

Define policies and processes to manage global product compliance, safety, testing and ethical sourcing standards.

Partner closely with Legal, EHS, Supply Chain, and third‑party testing bodies to mitigate risk, ensure market readiness and protect brand integrity across all territories.

Leadership & Collaboration
Build, inspire, and lead high-performing teams across Buying, Merchandising, Design, and Compliance. Including Direct Reports at Director and Senior Director level.

Partner closely with Franchise, Licensing, Marketing, Retail Operations, and external licensees, fostering a culture that balances creative ambition with commercial and operational rigor.

Collaborate across the Retail leadership team, ensuring close connection and understanding of Retail Operations, Retail.

Qualifications & Experience
Essential

Extensive, senior leadership experience in global retail product, buying, or merchandising, including major High Street, multi-sited operations.

Proven executive oversight of Buying, Merchandising, Design and Product Compliance at scale.

Strong commercial acumen with a track record of driving profitable, IP‑led retail businesses.

Experience leading large, multidisciplinary teams across North America, EMEA & APAC.

Deep understanding of global product safety, testing, regulatory standards and quality assurance.

Strongly Preferred
Experience within entertainment, media, themed attractions, or licensed consumer products.

Familiarity with owned retail, licensed, JV & third‑party operating models.

Experience aligning product strategies to content calendars, franchise launches, and major brand moments.

Demonstrated leadership in sustainability and responsible sourcing.

Leadership Attributes

Strategic, commercially driven and decisive.

Deep respect for creative storytelling, brand integrity and guest experience.

Comfortable operating in complex, matrixed global organizations.

Collaborative, influential, and confident at executive and board level.

Passionate about fan engagement and immersive branded experiences.

Measures of Success

Sustained growth in retail revenue, margin and inventory efficiency.

High guest satisfaction, conversion and product attachment rates across experiences.

Strong global compliance outcomes with minimal product risk exposure.

Creative excellence and franchise alignment across all product ranges.

A scalable, resilient global product organization with strong succession planning

Hybrid Working - This role is advertised as a Hybrid work model, that combines remote and in-office work, following our current company policy and to be agreed with your Line Manager. Subject to any applicable laws, WBD / your Line Manager reserves the right to change this working agreement where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Go-To-Market Systems
added.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit's growth is driving a rapid expansion of its world-wide team and the need for an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to support the global sales organization through the next several stages of growth. This role will report into the Go-to-Market Strategy organization, and support our major Go-to-Market Systems initiatives.

The Go-to-Market Systems team drives high impact projects that aim to build best-in-class tooling for our global sales organization, and enable seamless advertiser experiences.

As a Sr. Product Manager on the Go-to-Market Systems team, your focus will be to build the foundations, tools and workflows that will accelerate the growth and efficiency of our GTM organization.

You will own the vision, strategy and roadmap of sales technology projects that will drive organizational transformation for Reddit. You'll collaborate with other GTM leaders, product leaders, data teams, and engineering to run ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions.

Location
: Must be based within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York

Key Responsibilities

Define and drive the product vision, roadmap and architecture for our sales teams focused on growing our advertiser base.
Deeply understand problems faced by sellers and advertisers, and proactively identify opportunities to automate and improve the experience.
Build best-in-class tools that improve seller productivity in areas such as account planning, customer health scoring, relationship management, data quality and enrichment, LOB expansion, etc.
Improve the data foundations to power our AI-first strategy, including entity resolution, enrichment, and data orchestration.
Use experimentation, metrics, and customer feedback to measure impact on seller efficiency, revenue, and quality.
Lead cross-functional efforts across engineering, vendors, systems owners, and business stakeholders.
Translate GTM strategy and operational needs into scalable product capabilities, PRDs, success metrics, and engineering priorities.
Drive adoption and change management for new product capabilities across GTM teams.

Qualifications

7+ years of product management experience across GTM systems, Enterprise SaaS technology, and AI-powered tooling.
Strong fluency in modern GTM systems such as Salesforce, marketing automation, data enrichment tools, lead routing & scoring, billing, or customer lifecycle tools
Proven ability to drive cross-functional influence, strategic alignment, and executive communication.
Highly analytical and comfortable defining KPIs, running experiments, and using data to prioritize product investments
Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments that require continuous shaping, testing and quick improvements.

Benefits:

Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
401k with Employer Match
Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
Family Planning Support
Gender-Affirming Care
Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

Independently owns the vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and measurable outcomes for a complex or business-critical product or capability. Assess current-state capabilities, market and industry developments, operating performance, and business needs to identify strategic opportunities.
Facilitate cross-functional discussions with business and technology stakeholders to align priorities, define investment opportunities, resolve challenges, and advance product roadmaps.

Monitor product performance, roadmap execution, and value realization while communicating progress, outcomes, risks, and recommendations to business and executive stakeholders.

Integrates business architecture, platform modernization, solution design, data, automation, and delivery considerations into product strategy and roadmap decisions.

added.title: Director, Product Management, Partner Search
added.description:
Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

Director, Product Management, Partner Search

A Little About Us

Yahoo Search helps millions of people find information, answers, products, services, and inspiration across the web. In addition to our owned and operated Search experiences, Yahoo powers Search for a broad ecosystem of third-party distribution partners across browsers, software, APIs, and other consumer and B2B experiences.

The Partner Search team is responsible for growing and evolving that ecosystem. We build products and platform capabilities that help partners deliver high-quality Search experiences, grow user engagement and lifetime value, improve monetization, and scale their businesses with Yahoo. The team works at the intersection of consumer Search, partner platforms, APIs, monetization, traffic quality, data, and business development.

About The Role

We are seeking a Director of Product Management, Partner Search
to lead product strategy and execution for Yahoo’s third-party Search business.

This is a hands-on product leadership role that combines individual product ownership with people management. You will manage a small team of Product Managers while also directly owning a meaningful product area. Together, the team will be responsible for growing partner traffic and revenue, improving retention and lifetime value, increasing monetization, and making Yahoo’s partner Search platform more scalable and differentiated.

You will define product strategy across partner experiences, Search distribution, APIs, data and reporting, monetization, and platform capabilities. You will also identify and develop new B2B products and distribution opportunities that expand how partners can work with Yahoo.

The role requires strong commercial judgment, technical fluency, and comfort working directly with external partners. You will partner closely with Business Development and Partner Management, while serving as the senior Product counterpart in partner discussions, shaping joint product opportunities, diagnosing performance issues, and translating partner needs into scalable Yahoo products.

We are looking for someone who can operate like a product GM for the partner Search portfolio: setting direction, developing new ideas, driving measurable growth, coaching PMs, and personally getting into the details of product, data, APIs, traffic quality, monetization, and partner performance.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and performance of Yahoo’s Partner Search portfolio, with accountability for partner traffic, revenue, retention, lifetime value, monetization, and platform scalability.
Lead and develop a small team of Product Managers while personally owning a meaningful product area and remaining deeply engaged in product discovery, prioritization, execution, and performance.
Develop a deep understanding of distribution partners, their users, business models, traffic sources, and economics, using partner feedback, product data, market context, and performance trends to identify the highest-value opportunities.
Define product strategy for third-party Search experiences, balancing partner needs, end-user value, platform scalability, traffic quality, and Yahoo business objectives.
Improve partner configurability and flexibility across Search experiences, features, branding, data, APIs, and integrations, while avoiding excessive operational or technical complexity.
Drive initiatives that improve user retention, engagement, search volume, and lifetime value across distributed traffic, identifying and testing the product levers that strengthen repeat usage and partner economics.
Optimize monetization across partner experiences through new features, Search experience improvements, traffic and query optimization, and other product levers that improve revenue while maintaining partner and user value.
Identify, prototype, and launch new B2B Search products and distribution opportunities, including new partner capabilities, commercial experiences, APIs, and product models that expand Yahoo’s addressable market.
Build scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off partner solutions, including partner data and reporting, Search and XML APIs, syndication capabilities, configuration frameworks, and reusable platform services.
Own and improve critical partner ecosystem capabilities related to traffic quality, integrity, and compliance, including areas such as chain of custody, invalid traffic, domain matching, parked domain traffic, and partner traffic governance.
Use experimentation and performance measurement to guide decisions, define success metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and continuously identify new monetization and growth “jolts” across the partner portfolio.
Partner closely with Business Development, Partner Management, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Monetization, Legal, Privacy, and other teams to launch new capabilities and improve existing partner integrations.
Serve as a senior Product counterpart to strategic partners, helping shape joint product roadmaps, identify new opportunities, diagnose issues, and translate partner-specific needs into scalable product investments.
Monitor the health and evolution of the partner portfolio across adoption, traffic quality, retention, monetization, partner satisfaction, competitive dynamics, and platform cost to determine where to invest, simplify, or change direction.

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of Product Management or equivalent experience, including significant experience building and scaling consumer, platform, partner, distribution, or monetization products, with proven experience managing PMs and driving large-scale platform or distribution portfolios.
Experience leading Product Managers while continuing to operate as a hands-on product leader with direct ownership of meaningful product scope.
Demonstrated success growing a product or business through improvements in traffic, engagement, retention, lifetime value, revenue, monetization, or distribution.
Experience working with external partners in a B2B2C, platform, syndication, distribution, OEM, browser, marketplace, or similar ecosystem.
Strong product and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand partner economics, identify new growth opportunities, and balance partner needs with end-user and business outcomes.
Technical fluency sufficient to work deeply with engineers on APIs, partner integrations, data flows, platform architecture, experimentation systems, traffic quality, and scalable configuration capabilities.
Strong analytical skills and experience using product data, experimentation, cohort analysis, retention, LTV, traffic quality, and monetization metrics to guide product decisions.
Demonstrated ability to translate individual partner needs into scalable platform products rather than relying on one-off custom solutions.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to work directly with senior external partners and communicate product strategy, performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executives.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, identify new product opportunities, and move fluidly between long-term strategy and detailed product execution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Search distribution, sponsored Search, Search syndication, browser or OEM distribution, or other large-scale third-party Search ecosystems.
Experience building or managing Search APIs, XML APIs, syndication products, developer platforms, or APIs designed for third-party product integration.
Familiarity with Search monetization, RPM optimization, advertiser economics, traffic quality, invalid traffic, domain matching, parked domains, or related Search marketplace concepts.

added.title: Head of Product, Agentic Workflows
added.description:
We’re Changing the PropTech Industry

We’re a profitable, growth-stage company building industry-leading martech and data products for the PropTech space. Our focus is on our category-leading AI and data SaaS products with triple-digit growth rates.

We’re a fully remote team of 100+ spread across the U.S. from coast to coast. We operate on a strict no a**holes policy and are proud to have built a community of highly performant people that take our work seriously, but not ourselves. And, we're looking for exceptional people to help further accelerate our growth.

While we’ve raised $30MM+ to date from some of the world’s best investors, we’re profitable with a strong balance sheet and an indefinite runway. We pride ourselves on achieving rapid growth without having to incinerate capital.

About Our Products

ApartmentIQ is the all-in-one data platform powering smarter decisions across multifamily—covering 40M units with daily property and market intelligence used for surveys, research, and revenue management. We're trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI, delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to lead a new AI-native initiative. This is a 0-to-1 role: You’ll move from customer conversation to shipped product faster than most companies write a spec, work directly with customers, and build alongside product leadership, design, and engineering. We want someone who thinks like a product leader and can also get their hands dirty with design, prototyping, and rapid iteration. If you’ve been called “the person who just gets things built,” this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Own the product line end to end — from discovery and positioning through launch and adoption
Decide where models belong in the experience and where they don’t — the judgment calls that separate a product that is genuinely AI-native from AI bolted onto reporting
Ship fast. Write specs, design workflows, build prototypes, and work side-by-side with designers and engineers to get features into production
Design evaluation frameworks to systematically measure output quality — build test suites, analyze answer patterns and edge cases, and use those signals to iteratively improve performance
Define and validate the guardrails that make the product’s output safe, explainable, and trustworthy when real dollars ride on it
Shape the data foundation the product stands on — what we need, what has to be normalized, and which questions that finally lets us answer
Stand up customer feedback loops (weekly cadences with key accounts across operators, asset managers, and ownership groups) and use those signals to prioritize ruthlessly
Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and our existing product teams to make sure the product lands well and drives adoption

What We’re Looking For

Builder mentality over pedigree. We care about what you’ve shipped and how quickly
9+ years in product management at a high-growth startup or tech company — including at least one product you owned from 0-to-1, end to end
Shipped 0-to-1 products that customers actually use — not just features on a roadmap slide. Founder and co-founder backgrounds encouraged
Strong product instincts with design sensibility
Fluency in leading customer discovery and translating messy qualitative feedback into clear product direction
Experience defining quality metrics and building evaluation loops — you’ve measured whether something is working and used those signals to make it better
Hands-on with LLMs: A large part of this job is the model layer, so ideally you have built with modern AI tools or have a track record of learning new technology fast
Bias to action and iteration over perfection and process
A background in BI, analytics, or data platforms is welcome if you’re clear-eyed that this generation of the category gets built differently
Proptech, multifamily, or real estate experience is a plus but not required

Why Choose Us

Remote-First:
We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You’ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.
Competitive Compensation:
We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You’ll receive a
competitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.
Paid Time Off:
Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family’s biggest milestones.
Your Health Matters
: Stay healthy with high-quality Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Peace of Mind (On Us):
We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.
Protection for Your Whole Crew:
Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.
Invest in Your Future:
Secure your financial goals with our 401k Program, helping you build for the long term while you help us build the company.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process, please contact your recruiter.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

We want to alert you to potential recruiting scams targeting job seekers. Please note that our company will never request payment, personal information, or any confidential details during the interview process.

added.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Endpoint Security and XDR
added.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.

What You Will Be Doing:

Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.
Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.
Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.
Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.
Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.
Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.
Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.
Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

What You Bring:

Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.
Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.
Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.
A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.
A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.
A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.
Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

Bonus Points:

Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.
Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.
Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.
Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.
A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.
Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Security & Privacy Responsibilities:
Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

updated.title: Senior Director, Product Marketing
updated.description:
Datadog is looking for a Senior Director of Product Marketing to lead product marketing across Application Performance Monitoring (APM), Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM), and Developer Tools. You will lead the teams responsible for defining how these products compete, go to market, and grow. As a second-line leader, you will turn product strategy, competitive intelligence, market dynamics, customer needs, and product maturity into focused, full-funnel marketing strategies. This is an opportunity to own Product Marketing for three of Datadog’s fastest-growing product areas while helping define a new category we are entering.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

Lead and develop the Product Marketing organizations responsible for APM, DEM, and Developer Tools, coaching people managers and building high-performing teams capable of scaling with the business.
Own portfolio-level product marketing strategy across three distinct businesses, using market, customer, competitive, funnel, and financial insights to identify growth levers, prioritize investments, and establish clear strategies to win.
Partner with C-level executives and senior Product, Sales, and Marketing leaders to shape major product narratives, influence go-to-market priorities, and align product positioning with Datadog’s broader platform strategy.
Set the go-to-market direction for each product line, determining the right mix of launches, campaigns, content, customer programs, sales enablement, and other marketing tactics based on product maturity, audience, business objectives, and performance data.
Build a deep understanding of complex technical products, customers, and markets so you can challenge assumptions, strengthen positioning, guide teams through technical narratives, and connect product capabilities to measurable customer and business value.
Establish a culture of operational excellence, talent development, and accountability across the organization, including hiring, leadership development, organizational planning, prioritization, and continuous improvement of Product Marketing practices.

Who You Are:

An experienced Product Marketing leader with significant experience leading complex technical product portfolios and operating at senior leadership level; the Senior Director career path typically reflects 12+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree, 10 years with a Master’s degree, or equivalent experience.
A proven second-line leader with 5+ years of leadership experience and meaningful experience managing and developing people managers, building organizations, hiring exceptional talent, and growing future leaders.
A business-oriented leader who understands growth levers, business and financial performance, full-funnel marketing, and how to use quantitative and qualitative data to make portfolio-level decisions.
Deeply experienced in go-to-market strategy, with the judgment to select different positioning, launch, campaign, enablement, customer, and demand-generation approaches for products at different stages of maturity.
Technically credible and able to develop a strong command of sophisticated infrastructure, application, developer, or adjacent technologies, translating complex concepts into differentiated narratives and business value.
An influential executive communicator who can navigate ambiguity, align senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, make clear tradeoffs, and establish trusted partnerships across Product, Sales, Marketing, and other functions.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits & Growth:

Generous and competitive benefits package
New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
Employee-focused best in class onboarding
Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture
